objective:
Implement evidence/resume guard ONLY in scripts/verify-build-checkpoint.py and new tests/test_checkpoint_evidence.py. You are not alone; Codex owns docs/status/policy/research. No other writes, commits, push, external tools or subagents. Standard library, existing validate API, single-file hook exec compatibility. Reuse provided committed NotebookLM packet: argv/exit codes and byte hashing. Schema below is an owner-directed engineering contract, not NotebookLM fact.
Activation POLICY=docs/operations/checkpoint-evidence-policy.json (Codex creates). Exact object {schema_version:1,require_notebooklm_evidence:true,reject_completed_resume:true}. If present in base OR selected index/tree, validate regular JSON exact keys/types/values; require target present, no removal/downgrade. No policy in either: legacy behavior unchanged even with legacy research field. Receipt/status schema stay1. Empty staging unchanged. Use exact Git objects only.
Active receipts require notebooklm_research object: disposition new_verified|reused_verified|unavailable|administrative_no_new_claims; nonempty strings applicability,behavior_and_checks,gaps_and_next_action,external_submissions; records array of path/sha256 proofs. Check ALL proofs using existing safe_path/regular/hash/no-status-or-receipt-self-proof rules.
Verified dispositions require nonempty records. Each pinned record JSON: schema_version=1,kind=notebooklm_verified_findings, query:{path,sha256},verification:{path,sha256},findings:[...]. Validate query/verification proofs. Each finding: unique nonempty id,notebook_id,source_id,locator,finding,passage; verification_status=verified_applicable; nonempty arrays behaviors,checks of nonempty strings; source:{path,sha256}, validated. passage must occur verbatim in UTF8 source bytes. Query/source/verification proofs cannot reference the packet itself. Structural evidence is not source-truth certification; human review remains required. Malformed structures/UTF8/JSON fail cleanly.
Unavailable requires receipt missing_prerequisite and independent_action nonempty, never outcome complete; empty records allowed with applicability reason. Administrative allows empty records but disallows changed code/config/tests/deletions. Allow ONLY root AGENTS/CLAUDE/CURSOR/GROK/GROKBOTS/SKILLS/CURRENT_STATUS/README/ROADMAP/SECURITY/GOAL.md; docs/**/*.md; docs/operations/**/*.{json,log,txt}, except POLICY. Nonallowlisted changes reject admin. Any supplied record proofs still validated.
Resume: scan reachable historical RECEIPT versions from base via git log --format=%H --full-history BASE -- RECEIPT and exact tree reads. Collect normalized IDs with outcome complete. Reject next_task_id among completed unless next_task_reopen={task_id:matching next,reason:nonempty,evidence:{path,sha256}} valid. Validate any supplied reopen even if unnecessary. Keep existing complete-self-next rejection. Active blocked receipt cannot next itself. Normalize whitespace IDs. Missing historical file is absence; malformed/unreadable present receipt fails cleanly. Empty-tree base has no commit history.
Tests use temporary REAL Git indexes/trees: valid new/reused; missing research/fields/query/verification; arbitrary log as packet; wrong hashes, unstaged/untracked/symlink/self evidence; absent passage/malformed findings; code and deletion admin reject/docs admin pass; unavailable complete fail/honest partial pass; inherited policy remove/downgrade fail; legacy compatibility; older completed next rejection, valid reopen pass, malformed reopen fail, new task pass; committed-tree and merge history paths. Keep legacy tests unchanged. Run acceptance_commands. No root receipt edits. Return complete candidate inventory/tests/limits; configured model default, max160 actions/900sec.
